svg.title: Megumi Kijo — Hearth of the Hag. Draft 1 / Megumi Kijo classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Hagmother's Welcome forks into Teeth Behind the Smile then Appetite of Oblivion, or Numbing Lullaby then Cradle of the Kijo. Mountain Hag's Mercy forks into Nursed by Demon Hands then Laughter That Mends. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Megumi Kijo jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

The Control trait lives in one row: Phantom Realm Oblivion's 30% Decrease Damage Given on one enemy for 2 rounds, which is also the kit's only mitigation lever because it carries no Decrease Damage Taken and the bloodline has a standing 10% Increase Damage Taken passive. Sustain is real but thin: Laughter's Heal is one 400 HP tick on the following round and Kijo's Benevolence's 30% Increase Heal is a 2-round ground field the caster steps into. Absorb and move on Benevolence are unsupported; no Afterburn, Lifesteal, Reflect, IDG or IDT row exists, and none is invented."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Hagmother's Welcome","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"decreasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"},{"tag":"damage","flat":1,"display_role":"DAMAGE"}],"flavor":"Come in, traveller. BUFF","adverse":false,"base":1.0,"gain":0,"final":1.0,"calculation":"static","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Laughter That Mends"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has four supported tags on five rows (Damage x2, Decrease Damage Given x1, Increase Heal x1, Heal x1). The enemy-facing root (Hagmother's Welcome) forks into a damage route and a suppression route; the self-facing root (Mountain Hag's Mercy) is a single Foundation \u2192 Hidden \u2192 Advanced chain. A fourth route would have to split Heal from Increase Heal: a Heal-led Hidden Art under Mercy (+3) would already sit at the +5 guardrail with the Foundation's +2, so it could carry no capstone, and an Increase Heal-led second route would duplicate Nursed by Demon Hands. A Damage or Decrease Damage Given Hidden Art under Mercy is structurally legal (any two Advanced Arts would still cost 5 BP or more) but would duplicate the Welcome routes and open a second path to the +6 Damage / +10 DDG ceilings, so it is declined by choice. Three distinct complete builds exist (Burst, Suppression, Sustain); Burst and Suppression each have two fourth-purchase choices, and Sustain's fourth purchase is always Hagmother's Welcome (01,06,07,08 is legal and non-dominated).","design_notes":["Node split: the two roots are the hag's two faces. Hagmother's Welcome (enemy side) raises Phantom Realm Oblivion's suppression and both Genjutsu attacks, then forks into Teeth Behind the Smile \u2192 Appetite of Oblivion (damage) and Numbing Lullaby \u2192 Cradle of the Kijo (suppression). Mountain Hag's Mercy (self side) raises Laughter's Heal and Benevolence's Increase Heal in one chain through Nursed by Demon Hands \u2192 Laughter That Mends. 2/3/3; capstones are 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP.","Flats scale by coverage, not rank. Damage reaches 2 rows (Taiyo Kami: 3), so the route is 1+2+3 = +6 power at the guardrail (40\u219246, 45\u219251). Decrease Damage Given is a single-row enemy debuff and copies Taiyo's DDG route (2, 3, 5 = +10; 30\u219240%). Heal is single-row raw power held at the +5 guardrail (2 + 3 = 450 HP per tick). Increase Heal is 2/3/3 on the Mercy chain (maximum 8, 38%). Cradle's secondary is +2 Heal rather than +3 Increase Heal so that 01,04,06,07 is not dominated by 01,04,05,06.","Passives and main tree: the bloodline's Increase Damage Given passive (20% + 0.15/level, Genjutsu filter, no element) is bloodline-sourced and multiplicative, and its stat filter does not bind on element-less hits (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73), so it multiplies the enhanced Phantom Realm and Laughter rows. Its 10% Increase Damage Taken passive is a standing self-weakness; the kit has no Decrease Damage Taken, so the Lullaby route (one enemy's output \u221240% for 2 rounds) is the only mitigation lever.","Delivery and uptime: all cooldown 7. Phantom Realm Oblivion (single target, 60 AP) delivers hit and 2-round suppression at once. Onibaba's Laughter (radius-1 circle, 60 AP) hits each enemy inside; its SELF Heal (rounds 1) ticks once next round. Kijo's Benevolence (40 AP, empty-ground spiral) lays Increase Heal and absorb ground effects on every tile within 4 of the caster, then its move row moves the caster to the clicked tile, so it reaches them from the next round while they stand in it.","Fourth purchases: Burst \u2192 Mountain Hag's Mercy (Laughter 420 HP, field 32%) or Numbing Lullaby (suppression 35%); Suppression \u2192 Mercy (field 32%, Laughter 440 HP) or Teeth Behind the Smile (attacks 43/48); Sustain \u2192 Hagmother's Welcome only (suppression 32%, attacks 41/46). No-Advanced hybrids: 01,02,04,06 (Damage +3, DDG +5), 01,02,06,07 (Damage +3, IH +5), 01,04,06,07 (DDG +5, IH +5). Eight full allocations; all eight are numerically non-dominated and every node appears in at least one.","Strongest unadvertised builds: 01,02,04,05 (Damage +3, DDG +10, Heal +2) and 01,02,03,04 (Damage +6, DDG +5). By row weight Burst and Suppression tie at 18 and Sustain is 17 (Taiyo Kami 25\u201331 on nine rows). Lowest-value purchases by row weight: Numbing Lullaby and Nursed by Demon Hands (+3 on one row each), accepted because each gates a capstone and both rows act beyond their own output (every hit the suppressed enemy deals; every heal and absorb the field's holders receive)."],"risks":["Classification: every row is element-less, so no element isolates this kit. The tree requires the bloodline-keyed classification extension; under the current resolver a modifier would need affectedElements including None, which reaches every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts. NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT collision is unverified (no non-bloodline catalog with effect rows in the repository).","Suppression at 40%: Phantom Realm Oblivion's DDG row has no element and lists all four stat types, so for 2 rounds it reduces every non-pierce hit the debuffed enemy deals to anyone (caster, allies, summons), broader than one row suggests. It is one target per 7-round cooldown, debuff-prevent gated, and stacks with other DDG sources (BATTLE_TAG_STACKING on at the pin).","Pierce: Decrease Damage Given does not touch pierce hits, so the Suppression build is blind to pierce damage; the Damage route (raw power) and the Heal values are unaffected. Percentage caps are not approached (highest value 40%).","Increase Heal delivery: Benevolence's Increase Heal is a ground effect on every tile within 4 of the caster, re-applied each round to whoever stands there; the caster gets it only from the round after the cast (the move row relocates them last) and only while in the field. Allies in the field get it too (the dossier says self), so the Mercy chain lifts allied heals, lifesteal, vamp and absorb.","Increase Heal leakage: adjustHealGiven adds the percentage to heal_hp, lifesteal_hp, vampRatio and absorb_hp for the holder, so +8% also raises Benevolence's own unsupported 35% absorb and other healing in the window (max 38%). It ignores new or cast-this-round buffs; whether a ground-applied Increase Heal adjusts a same-round Laughter tick was not verified (621 vs 450 HP; baselines 520 / 400).","Heal timing: Onibaba's Laughter's Heal is target SELF with rounds 1, so it is one tick on the following round (static x10), deduplicated by stack key however many enemies the circle hits, and blocked by healprevent on the caster. +5 power is +50 HP per cast, once per 7-round cooldown; it is the kit's whole raw sustain and is held at the guardrail.","Damage is formula-calculated and scaled by the Genjutsu damage-given passive, so +6 raw power is not a linear +6; Laughter's +6 applies per enemy in its radius-1 circle (friendly fire ENEMIES, no ally hazard). The 10% damage-taken passive stays, and single-target suppression leaves it open against a second enemy. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked modes. No combat simulation.","Value decisions (user-owned): Damage +6 on two rows is at the guardrail (fallback +5: drop Welcome's +1 and leave it +2 DDG only); DDG +10 copies Taiyo Kami's single-row DDG route (fallback +8 with Cradle at +3); Heal +5 is at the guardrail. Absorb and move on Kijo's Benevolence are unsupported and get no direct potency; only the Increase Heal interaction touches absorb indirectly."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":8,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":3,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":4,"3":7,"4":8},"full_budget_allocations":8,"non_dominated_full_allocations":8,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"increaseheal":8,"heal":5},"supported_rows_in_kit":5,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagegiven":1,"heal":1,"increaseheal":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagegiven","heal","increaseheal"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 1 / Megumi Kijo classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Megumi Kijo jutsu inherit Megumi Kijo potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"decreasedamagegiven":5}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increaseheal":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"decreasedamagegiven":5,"increaseheal":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increaseheal":5,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"increaseheal":2,"heal":4}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"decreasedamagegiven":5,"increaseheal":5,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increaseheal":8,"heal":5}}]}

g.text: Draft 1 / Megumi Kijo classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Megumi Kijo jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Appetite of Oblivion path + Mountain Hag's Mercy
Cradle of the Kijo path + Mountain Hag's Mercy
Laughter That Mends path + Hagmother's Welcome
DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IH: Increase Heal
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Heal additions are raw power: each +1 Heal power is +10 HP per tick of a static heal.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
